text:
Hannah: Quick sync 10h before cut. Need owners for: SLA table, docs quickstart, support rota, monitoring dashboards, pricing stub. Keep answers short.

Luca: I'll own monitoring + alerts. Metrics: per-route p95, 5xx_rate, token/sec, cache_hit. Alerts: p95 > 350ms for 5m, 5xx_rate > 0.5% for 10m.

Sam: I'll draft SLA tiers and the incident runbook. Proposal: Standard 99.5% (email), Business 99.8% (8h P1), Enterprise 99.95% (2h P1 + AM). Runbook will include fallback routing to smaller model.

Meera: Docs + quickstart. Deliverables: JS + Python quickstart, streaming reconnect snippet, known-limits callout for alpha features. I'll include a short migration checklist.

Hannah: Pricing? Keep it simple for GA.

Sam: Recommend flat per-token + embedding unit, pilot coupon for early enterprise. FinOps sign-off required.

Luca: I'll add a synthetic streaming smoke test on deploy and a small Grafana dashboard JSON to the PR.

Meera: Docs PR incoming 1h. Will link code snippets and a short customer "what to expect" for first 14 days.

Hannah: Cut decision: mark custom quantization and latency-aware autoscale as alpha (not GA). Everyone OK?

Sam: Agree. We'll ship stable routing, model variants, and runbooks.

Luca: I'll wire alerts to Alertmanager and include a simple rollback snippet: `if p95 > 400ms then route -> smaller-model`.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Reminder: run smoke tests and validate token accounting.

Hannah: Owners recap: Monitoring  Luca; SLA/runbook  Sam; Docs  Meera; Pricing  Sam + FinOps. PR checklist before cut: SLA link, runbook link, docs link, dashboard link, pricing stub. If green 12h before canary we cut.
